test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All Indians are Americans.

Some Chinese are Americans.

All Chinese are Russians.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Chinese are Indians is a possibility.

(II) No Russian is an Indian.

(III) Some Americans are Russians.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4555c25783bf538fe22b35b281b87aaa999bc3462f0a6e3ca2f4fe69948065cf.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Chinese are Indians is a possibility. → **Follows** (As, there is no definite relation between Chinese are Indians, it is possible that some Chinese are Indians)

(II) No Russian is an Indian. → Does not follow (As, there is no definite relation between Russian and Indian. Hence, false) 

(III) Some Americans are Russians. → Follows (As, Some Chinese are Americans and All Chinese are Russians, which implies some Americans are Russians)

Hence, ‘**Both conclusions I and III follow**’ is the correct answer.
